## Goal
See GP-13: fail if any docs/user/*.md is not linked (directly or one hop) from INSTALL or GLOSSARY. A real gap → strict xfail naming WO-160.

## Acceptance criteria (testable)
- New/changed test file only, offline, no new dependencies; real gaps → strict xfail with reason, reported in VENDOR_STATUS.md. Never change `src/`.
- Run the test and ruff and report real numbers (if your shell is refused, say so; the owner reruns).
- Create no files outside the allowed paths.

## Allowed paths (the vendor may change ONLY these)
- tests/copilot/test_cp_user_docs_reachable.py
- VENDOR_STATUS.md

## Out of scope / do not touch
src/, packaging/, every file not listed above.
